entities.summary: Damian de Allende is a South African professional rugby union player who currently plays for the South Africa national team and Japanese club Saitama Wild Knights. His usual position is either centre or wing. He was a member of the Springboks team that won a third Rugby World Cup in 2019 and again that won a fourth Rugby World Cup in 2023. De Allende is a part of a few elite players to have won two world cup titles.
